# dsh-ip-studio — IP Content Studio (perceptive-gap writing)
**English** | 简体中文
Turn papers, notes and news into **publish-ready drafts** that build a personal IP, distributed as a

DeepSeek Harness (`dsh`) plugin. It is not an
account-coupled script pipeline: it keeps the hard-to

-copy asset — a perceptive-gap (认知差) writing
methodology — and turns the fragile platform glue into
pluggable, credential-separated external adapters.
## Why

Across the DSH plugin ecosystem there are notification bridges, WeChat-Reading tools and generic
"co

ntent generation" bundles, but **nothing focused on perceptive-gap writing plus multi-platform
draft

s** — while content / writing / marketing is the largest external paid category. This plugin fills
t
hat gap and, unlike a WeChat-only pipeline, stays safe to distribute: zero install scripts, credenti

als
kept outside the package.
## What it is (skill + tools)
- **Skill layer** — the perceptive-gap writing constitution is embedded via `ctx.skills.register(...

skeleton, wording red lines, hard layout rules, merge-and-self-check.
- **Tool layer (offline, dete

rministic)**:
- `ip_studio_review` — red-line and layout QC of a draft (banned wording, Markdown tab

les WeChat will not
render, non-ASCII image names, image count, title and Chinese-length budget). Re

turns `{ findings, publishable }`.
- `ip_studio_format` — Markdown to per-channel output: WeChat inl

ine-style HTML (using the
`rich_pages wxw-img` image-tag convention), Zhihu, Xiaohongshu, X thread s

plit, blog front-matter.
Returns `{ content, notes }`.
- **Publishing layer (not bundled)** — see `r

eferences/platform-adapters.md`.
Credentials come from the `config/publish.example.json` template vi

a an
external path; the actual platform API call is a user-owned script.
- **Portable Agent Skill**

— the same skill + the three commands packaged under
`skills/dsh-ip-studio/` so they install into Cl

aude Code / Cursor / Copilot
with no DeepSeek Harness (see Use as a standalone agent skill).

Requires the `dsh` CLI and an initialized profile (for example `web`).

After boot, the absence of `ip-studio ... failed to import` / `did not activate` means registration
succeeded. Profiles load the built `lib/`, so re-run `pnpm run build` and restart after editing `src
ed. Profiles load the built `lib/`, so re-run `pnpm run build` and restart after editing `src/*.ts`.
## Use as a standalone agent skill (no DeepSeek Harness)

The methodology and the three deterministic commands also ship as a portable
Agent Skill under
`skil

ls/dsh-ip-studio/` — the open `SKILL.md` format that installs into
Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot and

20+ other agents (and is what marketplaces such as Agensi.io list).
It runs the same `outline` / `re

view` / `format` logic through a dependency-free Node CLI, so it works
without `dsh`. Copy the folde
r into your agent's skills directory:
[代码示例省略，未执行]

Then just ask: *"turn this paper into a perceptive-gap WeChat draft."* The agent reads
`skills/dsh-i

p-studio/SKILL.md`, drafts from `references/methodology.md`, and calls
`node scripts/ip-studio.mjs o
utline|review|format` for the deterministic steps. Requires only Node.
## Use
Tell the model: *"use `ip-studio` to turn this paper into a perceptive-gap WeChat draft."* It produc

es the
draft, runs `ip_studio_review` for the final check, then `ip_studio_format` for layout. It st

ops at the
draft by default; publishing only starts when you explicitly ask to create/publish a draf

s at the
draft by default; publishing only starts when you explicitly ask to create/publish a draft.
## Security
- No postinstall / install scripts, no external binary downloads, no network calls from the plugin.

- Ships no secrets; credentials live only in an external file on the user's machine.
- Publishing is
always a manual-confirm step (an unverified personal account cannot publish via API).
## Publish your own
This package is set up for `github.com/CarryChang/dsh-ip-studio`. If you fork it, update `repository

` /
`homepage` / `bugs` and the docs to your owner, pass `pnpm run check`, then `npm publish` (`prep

ack`
rebuilds `lib`). To get listed on the DSH hub see `docs/hub-registration.md`
and tag the repo w
ith the `dsh-plugin` topic.
